definitions.R0: Ignore the model. For each temperature T, predict the mean true X-partition simplex of the k anchor compositions at that same T. This is the control: if R2 does not beat R0, no improvement beyond the anchors is demonstrated by R2 under this protocol.
definitions.R1: delta = mean over all k*11 anchor states of (true - raw model output); corrected = project_simplex(raw + delta). One 5-vector for the whole set.
definitions.R2: delta_T = mean over the k anchor states at temperature T of (true - raw model output); corrected = project_simplex(raw + delta_T). Eleven 5-vectors; exactly k anchor states feed each, so it is defined for every budget including k=1.
